hypothesis: B0-origin training can retain its ordinary-speech blank dominance while learning the shared positive recovery objective. A one-sided ceiling on ordinary nonblank-minus-blank margins tests whether it prevents false-event drift without forcing the student to copy B0 mistakes.
feature_frontend: 43876-parameter streaming FSMN-CTC; B0 and B9 mel filters, normalization mean and scale must be bit-equal before transfer. Original PCM16 features and greedy [1,2,3] event decoder unchanged.

pair.comparison_contract: Both cold-start arms use identical B0 tensors, original TRAIN samples, complete source-group draw, optimizer, normalization, decoder, natural negative objective and B9 positive-token retention. The only changed factor is ordinary B0 margin ceiling coefficient zero versus 0.08. No historical B13 tensor equality is claimed.

positive_teacher_archive.retention_gate: Two or more distinct TRAIN groups at one registered gain have a B9 and matched complete event on an original on which B13 candidate misses.

retention.eligible: Every admitted TRAIN original/gain for which B9 and B13 matched (natural weight zero) each greedily produce at least one complete contiguous [1,2,3]. Admission does not depend on B13 challenger response.
retention.teacher: Original byte-authenticated B9 complete-word TRAIN logits, with exactly the preexisting 120 eligible source/gain combinations. Both B17 arms receive the same nonblank token-identity retention.
retention.align: Use the nonblank frame runs of the first complete contiguous [1,2,3] in the B9 collapsed path on that original/gain. Each target token contributes its entire corresponding run of original frames. No forced linguistic alignments, no shifted indices and no transfer of times between originals.
retention.loss: For each B9-completed TRAIN source/gain/token nonblank frame, teacher margin is the target logit minus max of the OTHER TWO nonblank token logits, strictly classes 1..3 excluding the target; blank class 0 is not a competitor. Student margin uses identical two competitors; apply ReLU(teacher_margin-student_margin), averaging frames within token, tokens within word, gains/originals within group as in B14. No change to 0.08 auxiliary coefficient.
retention.draw: At zero-based step s use lexicographically sorted eligible source groups[s modulo 34]. Include all eligible source originals and all eligible gains from that group. This gives every eligible pair exposure and separates source, original, gain and token weighting.
retention.distinction_from_B1: B1 matched whole-clean-utterance four-class posterior distributions with a 0.22 KL contribution on positive and ordinary data. B14 preserves only target-vs-competing margins on the three nonblank runs of a previously completed positive word at native and reduced gains.
retention.fixed_weight_rationale: One coefficient 0.08 fixed to the existing additional natural-negative CTC coefficient. No sweep and no existing DEV signal used to choose its value.

ordinary_ceiling.teacher: Byte-frozen B0, no gradient or parameter updates; exact current sampled ordinary TRAIN source, gain, silence prefix and complete native frame grid.
ordinary_ceiling.sampling: Exactly the current ordinary synthetic source and the current owner-reviewed natural negative source in the common CTC draw, at gains 1.0 and 0.5. No positive row is admitted. Average tokens and frames, then gains within original, originals within source group, and the two selected groups equally.
ordinary_ceiling.frame_policy: The full same-source prefixed input is used. Student CTC log_softmax differences equal raw-logit differences, so no extra student forward is introduced.
ordinary_ceiling.one_sided: Lowering student nonblank-versus-blank margins below the frozen teacher has zero loss. No B0 false event, full posterior or four-class distribution must be reproduced.
ordinary_ceiling.coefficient_rationale: Fixed to the existing 0.08 auxiliary objective scale before optimization; no sweep or score-dependent selection.
ordinary_ceiling.distinction_from_B1: B1 used full-utterance four-class posterior matching with 0.22 KL. B17 uses only ordinary TRAIN one-sided token-vs-blank upper bounds, with B0 as the shared initialization and ordinary teacher.

train_mechanism_gate.population: All 79 admitted original synthetic TRAIN and all nine exact owner-reviewed natural windows, never the unreviewed 24-window collection.
train_mechanism_gate.new_model_forwards: B0 on all 88*3 original TRAIN conditions; B9 only on the 44*3 ordinary conditions. Reuse original saved B9 logits for all 44*3 positive conditions.
train_mechanism_gate.margin_elevation: Mean ReLU((B9[k]-B9[0])-(B0[k]-B0[0])) over k=1..3 and original frames is strictly positive on at least one registered gain. This measures model drift, not a quality-pass threshold.
train_mechanism_gate.positive_recovery: At one registered gain, B9 has a complete [1,2,3] greedy event on the same admitted positive original for which B0 has none.
train_mechanism_gate.stop: If either minimum fails, save the complete TRAIN diagnostic and STOP before any optimizer update. Do not change the gate or run additional cohorts to force a signal.
train_mechanism_gate.selection_use: Confirms the predeclared TRAIN mechanism only; never model promotion or a replacement for independent DEV.

source_policy.allowed: Exactly the old 79 synthetic TRAIN and nine owner-reviewed natural windows, their authenticated existing B9 teacher evidence, plus frozen B0/B9 checkpoint tensors.
forbidden: Any primary/replication/DEV waveform or logit in optimization
Any CAL or LOCKED source or metric
Fresh audio generation, ASR, phone teachers or forced alignment
Threshold or coefficient selection on scored data
Work/Codex training credits or private repositories

start_condition: Freeze and authenticate this design and the independent B17 source/quality assessment before any new model forward or optimizer update; source lineage and original bytes must pass. A single reviewed public Actions push with exact predecessor and attempt one is required.
artifact_contract: Each arm saves actual PT/NPZ/ONNX, exact saved tensor/readback parity, all 192 optimizer steps, original source manifest and model hashes. ONNX structural check is not C11/ARM parity. B0 remains installed.
